authentication.description: Sign in once via Supabase OAuth, then connect an MCP client to https://ceoowl.com/mcp. See https://ceoowl.com/docs for client configuration.

description: Private English grammar checking. The web editor runs the Harper engine on your device so checked text never leaves the browser; AI clients connect to the same checker over a signed-in MCP connection. English only. Submitted text is processed in memory and never stored.
name: CEO Owl

skills.description: Find grammar, spelling, punctuation and style problems in English text. Returns findings with character offsets and suggested replacements.
skills.name: Check English grammar
